Three sizes only (26X11/30X13/35X15); no XL-XXL, and Medium is down to 16 in stock on q1,527.

Taksali 5" and 7" each sold on a single day only — indent buys, not held stock.
Largest SKU is a 7-inch Taksali at ~Rs400; no Siri Sahib or ceremonial piece.

Kara, kangha, kachhera, kirpan and gatra all exist singly, but no bundle/gift-box SKU.
No gutka, pothi or bani title anywhere in the catalogue.
